authority: FOUNDER RULING 2026-08-18 — D1 through D5. Encoded as founder-authored policy; no Claude recommendation was converted into founder authorship.

D1.evidenceSource: aura_final/lib/core/compliance/report_repository.dart:47-75 — the shipped ReportReason enum and its stable wire tokens
D1.nothingInvented: All six already shipped. No category was added from moderation theory.
D1.gapsReported: None omitted for lack of evidence — every shipped category had evidence.
D1.enforcement: Write boundary (CreateReportDto), NOT a database enum. Converting the existing String column would require rewriting historical rows: production-data mutation, unauthorized, and adjudication data is evidence that must not be patched.
D1.productionSafety: Verified the shipped client sends reason.wire (report_repository.dart:114), so the governed set matches live traffic exactly and no reporting path breaks.
D1.recordedNotResolved: AIReportCategory is a separate DB-enforced 7-member enum for AI-response reports whose vocabulary overlaps without matching. NOT merged — that would author policy by inference. Founder disposition owed; blocks nothing.

D2.action: Existing 14-action ladder ratified as canonical policy.
D2.why: Every destructive action already has a restore path, which is what the destructive boundary requires. What it lacked was authorship, not correctness.

D3.chain: AUTOMATED EXAMINATION -> QUARANTINE -> NOTICE -> HUMAN APPEAL/REVIEW -> FINAL GOVERNED DISPOSITION
rejected: ADVISORY_ONLY — a scanner whose verdict cannot stop delivery is not an examination system
SILENT_AUTO_FINAL — irreversible product harm from a false verdict
D3.appealStanding: Content authority under Aura's existing model. NEVER created by possession of an id, URL or reference — the same principle D7 froze.
D3.timing: No invented SLA. Prioritized queue, visible status, explicit quarantine, and neither silent permanent removal nor silent timer auto-release.
D3.blockedBy: CH-12 examination mechanism, itself gated by G1 leg 5(B)

D4.endState: All uploaded media classes within governed scope
D4.phase2: Remaining governed classes — a NAMED CH-12 CLOSURE REQUIREMENT, not an optional enhancement
D4.invariant: ALL APPLICABLE F137 MEDIA CLASSES MUST BE COVERED BEFORE CH-12 CLOSURE
frozenAdequacyPreserved: quarantine as reversible retention, never deletion

D5.result: CH-15 nonGoal STANDS; the conflicting founderActions wording is SUPERSEDED by ruling. F095 stays with the Live/surface owner under HOLD, and must consume CH-15's contract rather than reimplement policy.

buildAttribution.authorized: FOUNDER RULING 2026-08-18 — bounded artifact-identity mechanism sufficient for live certification

buildAttribution.honesty: `attributable:false` is returned when neither a build id nor a commit is present — the explicit signal that a certification attempt must record NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than PASS.
buildAttribution.compatibility: Purely additive; every existing field keeps its name, type and meaning, so Railway probes and existing consumers are unaffected.
